name: roll front shoulder and chest lying on floor
description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the front shoulder and chest. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie face down with the roller under your front shoulder.
Place the roller under the front shoulder and chest and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll small amounts toward the chest and back.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
